Our vision is to change that by building AI companions that seamlessly take over digital workflows. We don’t replace humans with technology - we amplify their impact. voize is backed by Ycombinator and Europe’s leading VCs, already installed in over 2.000 senior care homes and trusted by more than 200.000 users . With our self-developed voize AI, we’re transforming the healthcare industry and creating value in other sectors too.
